damping_only.acceptance_note: Independent full replay and all numeric task gates pass in damped_complete. No complete video inspection was performed for this lower-performing ablation, so it is not accepted as the final result.

reference_interpolation_and_damping.acceptance_note: Rejected: independent full replay reports only 0.260384 N terrain load at initial opening, below the unchanged 70% weight gate. Other numeric physical gates pass. Exact paired handoff evidence is attached.

interpretation.entry: Angular speed RMS 0.00410 rad/s and alpha RMS 0.10691 rad/s² over final 1s before descent rule out residual brake motion as the main source.
interpretation.early_descent: 50Hz position IK setpoint holds excite physical hand/object torque oscillations; interpolation-only intervention suppresses early acceleration with grip unchanged. Velocity feed-forward and effort caps are unchanged.
interpretation.later_descent: Native carriage damping is canceled by q+(preload+3*qvel)/800. Net force becomes preload. Damping-only and combined continuations show that dissipative grip and arm feedback suppress slower body/grasp motion. Arm and carriage damping are tested together, so their individual causal contributions are not separately identified.
interpretation.terrain: Most acceleration energy occurs while airborne. Asymmetric touchdown and hand constraints add a secondary impulse/rocking transient. The combined intervention reduces touchdown angular and downward speeds without changing release gates.
interpretation.release: Original release already follows sustained physical support. Release/withdrawal trajectories and sustained physical support gates are retained. The selected version also preserves the arm reference at load confirmation and rechecks current support before opening. Release energy was a small part of the regression.
interpretation.limits: Interpolation-only fails with a left toe terrain impulse and is rejected. No model, walking, pickup, contact parameters, effort caps or policies changed. Four focused continuations test two interventions and repair their load-confirmation handoff; no sweep.

handoff_ablation.diagnostic_columns: local_sec, lift, left/right_hand_force_norm, left/right_net_squeeze, terrain_vertical_force, arm_fit_cost, six_impulse_sums
handoff_ablation.conclusion: Continuity at load confirmation removes the opening-step unloading disturbance. The same sustained support gate and opening time are used. The new controller also rechecks current support before opening.
